briefings.title: Defense Secretary, Joint Chiefs Chair & Agriculture Secretary Testify before Senate
briefings.tldr: The Trump administration is seeking an $87.6 billion supplemental funding package—as part of a broader $1.5 trillion defense goal—to sustain the ongoing conflict with Iran, replenish depleted munition stockpiles, and provide emergency relief to an agricultural sector crippled by high input costs and trade disruptions.

briefings.title: JUST IN: Secretary Of Agriculture Brooke Rollins Hosts Other Cabinet Members For Press Conference
briefings.tldr: The Trump administration marked Tax Day by highlighting the "Working Families Tax Cut Act," which delivers historic relief to middle-class Americans and rural communities, while simultaneously announcing the launch of the first-ever USDA Office of Seafood to integrate fishermen into federal agricultural support programs.
